summary.text: Matt McKee was elected to the Arkansas Senate in 2022 and sworn in on January 9, 2023; he represents District 6, which includes parts of Garland and Saline counties.

paragraphs.text: He was a Garland County Justice of the Peace from 2009 through 2022 and chaired the Republican Party of Garland County from 2015 through 2022.
Born in Colorado, he moved to Hot Springs in 2002, is a licensed residential remodeler, and lives in Pearcy with his wife, Nikki.
